user.title: Set up Antiflap
user.description: Create a binary sensor that resists short inactive/request gaps by holding on longer after repeated short gaps.

data_description.input_entity: Entity to apply the Antiflap logic to.
data_description.active_state: Input entity state that means active. Leave blank to choose a default based on the entity type.
data_description.free_flaps: How many flaps are ignored before adaptive hold begins. Leave blank to use the integration default.
data_description.flap_gap_seconds: Inactive gaps at or below this duration count as flaps when the input becomes active again. Leave blank to use the integration default.
data_description.base_hold_seconds: The first hold duration after the free flaps are exceeded. Leave blank to derive it from flap gap and minimum base hold.
data_description.min_base_hold_seconds: Minimum derived base hold when base hold seconds is blank. Leave blank to use the current flap gap seconds.
data_description.hold_factor: Multiplier used to grow each additional hold duration. Leave blank to use the integration default.
data_description.max_hold_seconds: Maximum hold duration. Leave blank to use the integration default.
data_description.min_on_seconds: Minimum time the Antiflap sensor must stay on after it turns on. Leave blank to use the integration default.
data_description.window_seconds: How long recent flaps are remembered. Leave blank to auto-size it based on hold factor and flap gap.
